public_input.query: I'm a vintage fashion enthusiast visiting London during carnival weekend. I absolutely must visit Portobello Road Market for its famous antiques and vintage finds - it's been on my bucket list! I also love art galleries and want to discover both famous and hidden gem museums. I prefer to do my serious shopping on weekends when I have more time to browse, and I'd like at least 2 different types of vintage or fashion shopping experiences. I want to eat like a local and avoid upscale tourist restaurants - I prefer casual, authentic spots with popular local recommendations.
